Labelled 2026-10-11.
_rubric: Label the committee(s) a bill responding to the story would be referred to under House Rule X / Senate Rule XXV (or the authorizing committee of the agency the story is about), in each chamber; more than one when the story spans subjects or jurisdiction is shared. None for stories with no federal policy subject: campaign horse races and polls, foreign events with no U.S. government actor, crime and trials of private people, disasters and weather with no government response, business, sports, entertainment. A Senate-only matter (a nomination, the filibuster) has no House committee.
